shortDefinition: A subfield of machine learning using neural networks with many layers to learn complex patterns from data.
fullDefinition: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers ('deep' architectures) to learn complex representations from large amounts of data. It is the technology behind image recognition, speech-to-text, LLMs, and generative AI. Deep learning became practical in the 2010s with the availability of large datasets, powerful GPUs, and architectural innovations like transformers.
